invented.quote: Each book also takes me about four months of full-time work.
invented.why: The brief says each book takes about four months, not that it is four months of full-time work.

invented.quote: My fees elsewhere have gone up as well.
invented.why: The brief only gives a single fee of $12,500 from another publisher last year and does not state that the illustrator's fees elsewhere have increased over time.

invented.quote: Last year another publisher paid me $12,500 for a 32-page book of the same scope.
invented.why: The brief says the other book was of the same length (32 pages), but does not say it was of the same scope (such as having about 14 full spreads).
